settings.author: Mary Crawford
settings.title: Perfect for church
settings.body: Fits down the church aisle and I can raise the seat to see over the pew in front. Small things that matter.

settings.author: Marcia Campbell
settings.title: Wish I'd bought one sooner
settings.body: Spent three years with an uncomfortable powerchair before discovering the M4. What a difference. Don't hesitate — just buy one.

settings.author: Ernest Boothroyd
settings.title: Five stars isn't enough
settings.body: If I could give six stars I would. The M4 has given me back my independence, my social life, and my dignity. I cannot recommend it highly enough.

settings.author: Mei Chen
settings.title: Lovely smooth ride
settings.body: The ride quality is wonderful. Smooth, quiet, and comfortable. It feels like gliding rather than rolling. Makes every journey a pleasure rather than an ordeal.

settings.author: Bernard Kelley
settings.title: Workshop access
settings.body: I have a small woodworking workshop and the M4 lets me move between benches easily. Sideways movement is key.

settings.author: Priya Sharma
settings.title: Love the indicator lights
settings.body: The LED lights on the M4 are a nice touch. They make me visible in the dark winter evenings which is important for safety. Thoughtful design detail.

settings.question: What makes an XSTO wheelchair different?
settings.answer: The range combines electric mobility with features such as self-levelling control and adjustable seating. The M4 and M4B focus on everyday use, the M4 Pro adds more seating adjustment, and the X12 adds stair-climbing capability. Compare the models around the places you need to go.

settings.question: Can all XSTO wheelchairs climb stairs?
settings.answer: No. The X12 is the stair-climbing model in this range. The M4, M4B and M4 Pro are not stair-climbing chairs. For the X12, suitable stair dimensions, surface conditions, an assessment and proper training are essential.

settings.question: Can I try a wheelchair before buying?
settings.answer: Yes. Request a demonstration with the UK team. Tell us which models interest you, your location and the everyday situations you would like to try. The team will confirm availability and arrangements.

settings.question: How does VAT relief work?
settings.answer: Qualifying customers can buy eligible products without VAT for personal or domestic use. Eligibility is not automatic; you must complete a declaration. Both VAT-relief and VAT-inclusive prices are shown. Read the VAT relief guide or ask the team for help.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside the UK?
settings.answer: Please enquire before ordering internationally. Product availability, local support, delivery, import charges and destination requirements need to be confirmed for your country. The UK delivery offer does not apply to overseas orders.
